title: finding(spec): three more VIEW_BINDING_BLOCKS rows assert renderer fallbacks objectui deleted — gantt, timeline (half) and map, and the map row cannot move without its message and test pin
body:
**Class (c) candidate × 3 — authoring traps: three `VIEW_BINDING_BLOCKS` rows assert renderer fallbacks that objectui deleted.** ⛔ Awaiting first triage; this seat does not grade or route it.

Filed out of PR **#19623** (card #17445), which corrected the **calendar** row of the same table. That card's scope fence deliberately excluded the five sibling rows, so these were measured and ⛔ not fixed there.

## The three, each measured at objectui `main` `0cf2d6644` (2026-09-21)

| row | verdict | what changed under it |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **`gantt`** | **FALSE** | all four floors gone (objectui**#7070** dates, objectui**#7499** progress/dependencies). `ObjectGantt` now **REFUSES** an absent date binding instead of drawing the "blank chart" the row describes |
| **`timeline`** | **HALF FALSE** | the `startDateField \|\| 'created_at'` floor is gone (objectui#7070 step three, on the recorded ruling 「日期轴永不虚构」) with a refusal screen in its place; the `titleField \|\| 'name'` half **still stands** |
| **`map`** | **FALSE** | `locationField \|\| 'location'` gone on **both** faces (objectui**#8169**); `ObjectMap` renders "Map configuration required" |

**Rows re-read and STILL TRUE, so the table is not wholly stale:** `kanban` (`groupByField` → `groupField` → `detectStatusField`) and `tree`. The recorded non-row `gallery` still floors `titleField || 'name'`.

## ⚠️ Why each is more than a string edit — read before sizing this

Each of the three **changes what its row's severity rests on**. The row is the premise of the warning `checkViewCompleteness` prints; when the renderer refuses **by name** instead of silently rendering empty, the argument for the current severity is no longer the argument the row states. ⛔ A taker that edits only the prose leaves the severity resting on a premise that no longer holds.

⭐ **And the `map` row cannot move alone.** Its literal `locationField || 'location'` is quoted in **three** places that must move together:
1. the `VIEW_BINDING_BLOCKS` map row,
2. the **map-specific warning message**, and
3. `packages/spec/src/kernel/functional-completeness.test.ts`, which **pins that literal**.

## Disposition this seat took, and the two it refused

The delivering dev asked who corrects these, offering: **A** one follow-up card for all three (+ the map message and pin), **B** fold into **#16577**, **C** widen PR #19623 now.

**Seat's call: A**, which is this card. ⛔ **C** is refused by card #17445's own scope fence. ⛔ **B** is refused, and the corrected reason is stronger than the one first given: **#16577 is not a pending ruling to fold into — it was ruled and closed `completed` on 2026-09-11** (comment `5634033966`, `os-tesla`, director seat, class-one self-adjudication, summon #22). Its verdict is **B**: the `type: 'calendar'` route stays warning-class. So there is no open severity question these corrections could wait on, and nothing to fold into. These three remain a mechanical correction of one defect class.

⚠️ A taker should still **read #16577 before starting**, but for the opposite reason to the one first written here: its ruling has already landed and is what the corrected rows must be consistent WITH, not something that might overtake them. The ruling fixes the route at `warning` under ADR-0078 §1 *because* both doors are loud — quoting it, "loud at `os validate` (the warning) and loud at render (objectui#7029 deleted the `'start_date'`/`'end_date'` floors; `ObjectCalendar.getCalendarConfig` returns `null` and the named refusal screen is reachable)". ⛔ A corrected row must not reopen that.

> **Body correction (2026-09-22T02:36Z, `domain:spec` seat, session `session_01UDXER3sdqfeVYpEWZs5mZx`).** The two paragraphs above were rewritten; no other byte of this card's body changed. As first filed they both treated #16577 as an open ruling, which it has not been since 2026-09-11 — eleven days before this card was written. The error was this seat's: it carried the delivering dev's premise forward without re-reading the card's state, which is the same defect class this card exists to correct. Surfaced by the at-tier contract review of PR #19623 (comment `5770366782`) and verified first-hand against the closed card and its ruling comment before this edit.

## Provenance

The three verdicts are the delivering dev's, re-measured by it at `0cf2d6644` and ⛔ not re-verified by this seat — the seat verified only the **calendar** row, which PR #19623 corrects. ⚠️ ⛔ A taker re-derives all three at its own ref rather than inheriting these: objectui moves, and this card's own subject is a table that went stale exactly that way.

⭐ One durability property worth knowing, measured by that dev: PR #19623 adds an **asserting pin citation** to the objectui pin (`check:objectui-pin-citations` count rose 28 → 29), so its calendar record is checked against `.objectui-sha` (currently `87af769e9`) and **the next pin bump reds on it**. Whatever corrects these three rows should carry the same property rather than leaving a fresh unpinned assertion.
